_note: The grounding validator's test corpus. Synthetic identities only — no real bank, person or regulator appears here. Each case declares the EXACT set of codes it must produce, so a rule that stops firing fails as loudly as one that starts over-firing. The accepted cases matter as much as the rejected ones: a validator that refuses everything would pass a rejection-only corpus and ship a feature that never works.
